evidence.evidenceMissing: We lack data on how competing products handle similar save-latency constraints.
assumptions: The observed super-linear scaling is not an artifact of the measurement harness.
Users will tolerate current save latency for another quarter.

ownerDecision.decisionTitle: Park save-latency research until Q2 planning
ownerDecision.researchEvidenceReviewed: Problem discovery prob-disc-0001, experiment log exp-log-0001, source review src-review-0001.
ownerDecision.mainFinding: Save latency is a real and measurable problem with super-linear scaling, but the current release schedule has higher-priority items.
ownerDecision.risks: Users may experience increasing frustration; large documents may become practically unusable if document size continues to grow.
ownerDecision.openQuestions: How will the planned collaboration rewrite affect the save path? Will it make the current bottleneck irrelevant?
ownerDecision.recommendedNextPhase: Revisit in Q2 planning when collaboration architecture is more defined.
ownerDecision.rationale: Fixing save latency now risks duplicating effort if the collaboration rewrite changes the serialization path. Better to align optimization with the new architecture.
ownerDecision.constraints: No save-path changes in Q1. Performance telemetry collection should continue.
ownerDecision.nextActions: Continue collecting telemetry. Add a dashboard widget tracking P95 save latency per document size bucket.
